This funding comes just nine months after Payabli raised its Series A led by QED Investors bringing the total capital in the company to date to $60,000,000. The Series B is led by Fika Ventures and QED Investors with participation from existing investors TTV Capital and Bling Capital. This follow-on funding is a testament to Payabli’s significant growth over the past year, marked by the activation of multiple billions in live processing volume and a 7x year-over-year increase in revenue. ...
